# Preqin Website

> Preqin is the global leader in alternative assets data, research, and analytics, providing institutional investors, fund managers, and advisors with tools to evaluate private equity, venture capital, private credit, hedge funds, real assets, and infrastructure opportunities.

## Markdown Content Access

Most content pages support a machine-readable **Markdown alternative**. Append `.md` to any supported slug to receive the page content as plain Markdown with YAML frontmatter instead of HTML.

### How it works

- **`.md` extension** — Append `.md` to the end of any supported content URL slug.
  Example: `/insights/research/articles/my-article.md`
- **`Accept` header** — Send `Accept: text/markdown` in your request headers.
- The response is served with `Content-Type: text/markdown; charset=utf-8`.
- Public content is cached (`max-age=300, stale-while-revalidate=3600`); restricted content returns `no-store`.

### Supported content types

The following page types support the `.md` alternative:

- **Insights articles** — `/insights/research/:contenttype/:slug.md`
- **Insights reports** — `/insights/research/:contenttype/:slug.md` (multi-chapter reports)
- **Legacy articles** — `/insights/research/:contenttype/:slug.md` (articleNew format)
- **News** — `/news/:slug.md`
- **Videos** — `/insights/research/videos/:slug.md`
- **Podcasts** — `/insights/research/podcasts/:slug.md`
- **Brochure articles** — e.g. `/customer-testimonials/:slug.md`, `/academy/preqin-academy-insights/:slug.md`, `/help-center/:slug.md`
- **Help center articles** — `/help-center/articles/view/:slug.md`

### Response format

Responses include YAML frontmatter followed by the Markdown body:

```
---
title: "Article Title"
contentType: article
date: "2025-01-15"
slug: my-article
author:
  - Preqin
accessLevel: public
insightType: Research
---

# Article Title

Body content in Markdown...
```

### Localisation

All page routes accept an optional `/:lang?` prefix for locale-specific content (e.g. `/cn/insights/research/articles/my-article.md`).

## Products

- [Our Products](https://www.preqin.com/our-products): Preqin's suite of alternative investment tools for private markets data, benchmarks, research, fundraising and portfolio monitoring.
- [Preqin Pro](https://www.preqin.com/our-products/preqin-pro): Private capital and hedge fund datasets covering fund managers, investors and company intelligence.
- [Preqin Private Markets](https://www.preqin.com/our-products/insights-plus): Private markets research and analysis across alternative assets, fundraising and performance trends.
- [Preqin Term Intelligence](https://www.preqin.com/our-products/term-intelligence): Fund terms benchmarking and due diligence data across alternative investments.
- [Preqin Company Intelligence](https://www.preqin.com/our-products/company-intelligence): Market intelligence, private company valuations, investors, deals and company data.
- [Preqin Enterprise Data Solutions](https://www.preqin.com/our-products/enterprise-data-solutions): APIs, workflows and alternative assets intelligence at scale.
- [Preqin Transaction Intelligence](https://www.preqin.com/our-products/transaction-intelligence): Private market transaction data, deals, valuations and investment research workflows.

## Data & Benchmarks

- [Our Data](https://www.preqin.com/data/our-data): Preqin data solutions — private markets datasets, benchmarks and intelligence across funds, investors, deals and companies.
- [Asset Classes](https://www.preqin.com/data/asset-classes): Preqin's data coverage across private equity, venture capital, private credit, hedge funds and real estate.
- [Preqin Benchmarks](https://www.preqin.com/data/preqin-benchmarks): Preqin private market benchmarks and indices for fund performance and alternative assets.
- [Free Benchmarks](https://www.preqin.com/data/free-benchmarks): Free Preqin benchmarks for private markets, including private equity performance and indices.
- [Data Coverage Map](https://www.preqin.com/data/data-coverage-map): Preqin's global data coverage map for private markets, funds, investors, deals and alternative assets by region.
- [Profiles](https://www.preqin.com/data/profiles): Preqin data profiles for fund managers, investors, companies, funds and deals across private markets.
- [Venture Capital](https://www.preqin.com/data/venture-capital): Preqin venture capital database — VC funds, managers, investors, rankings, fundraising, due diligence and valuations.
- [Private Equity](https://www.preqin.com/data/private-equity): Preqin private equity database — benchmarks, fundraising, due diligence, deals and performance intelligence.
- [Hedge Funds](https://www.preqin.com/data/hedge-funds): Preqin hedge fund database — fund managers, performance, rankings, due diligence and research.
- [Private Capital Salary Calculator](https://www.preqin.com/data/private-capital-salary-calculator): Preqin's private capital salary calculator benchmarking compensation trends across private equity and alternative assets roles.

## Solutions

- [Solutions](https://www.preqin.com/solutions): Preqin alternative investment solutions for private markets data, fundraising, investor relations, benchmarks and research.
- [Fundraising](https://www.preqin.com/solutions/fundraising): Preqin fundraising solutions to identify investors, track private markets activity and support capital raising strategies.
- [Investor Relations](https://www.preqin.com/solutions/investor-relations): Preqin investor relations solutions for LP insights, fundraising activity and relationship intelligence.
- [Benchmarking](https://www.preqin.com/solutions/benchmarking): Preqin benchmarking to compare private equity performance, fund metrics and peer data.
- [Fund Terms Benchmarking](https://www.preqin.com/solutions/benchmarking-fund-terms): Preqin Term Intelligence for benchmarking fund terms using private markets data and market comparisons.
- [Private Credit](https://www.preqin.com/solutions/private-credit): Preqin private credit solutions for private debt data, fundraising, benchmarks and market intelligence.
- [For Fund Managers](https://www.preqin.com/our-clients/fund-managers): Preqin solutions for fund managers, including fundraising data, investor intelligence and benchmarks.
- [For Investors](https://www.preqin.com/our-clients/investors): Preqin solutions for investors, including private markets data, due diligence and benchmarks.
- [Sustainability](https://www.preqin.com/sustainability): Preqin sustainability data for private markets, ESG insights, fund manager policies and responsible investment analysis.

## Insights & Research

- [Insights](https://www.preqin.com/insights): Preqin private markets research, insights and analysis on alternative assets, fundraising, performance and market trends.
- [First Close](https://www.preqin.com/firstclose): First Close by Preqin — private markets newsletter, fundraising insights, private credit trends and alternative assets analysis.
- [Conferences and Events](https://www.preqin.com/insights/conferences-and-events): Preqin conferences and events for private credit, private equity, venture capital and alternative investment insights.
- [Preqin Academy](https://www.preqin.com/academy): Preqin Academy — private markets education, alternative assets research and data training resources.

## Company

- [Preqin](https://www.preqin.com): Preqin alternative assets data, private markets research, benchmarks and investment intelligence for investors and fund managers.
- [Who We Are](https://www.preqin.com/about/who-we-are): About Preqin — a private markets data and research provider serving investors, fund managers and alternative assets professionals.
- [Corporate Responsibility](https://www.preqin.com/about/our-corporate-responsibility): Preqin corporate responsibility, sustainability commitments and support for private markets transparency and data quality.
- [Partners](https://www.preqin.com/about/partners): Preqin partner programs and community partnerships supporting private markets data and research.
- [Press Hub](https://www.preqin.com/about/press-hub): Preqin press hub — company news, research announcements and alternative assets insights.
- [Press Releases](https://www.preqin.com/about/press-release): Preqin press releases — company news, product updates and alternative assets data announcements.
- [Careers](https://www.preqin.com/about/careers): Preqin careers and jobs in private markets data, technology, research and sales.
- [Customer Testimonials](https://www.preqin.com/customer-testimonials): Preqin testimonials and reviews from investors, fund managers and private markets teams.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://website-cms-api-passthrough.iridium.pro.preqin.com/v1/api/public/preqin/sitemaps/file/sitemap.xml): Full XML sitemap of website pages.
- [Public Profiles Sitemap](https://website-cms-api-passthrough.iridium.pro.preqin.com/v1/api/public/preqin/sitemaps/file/public-profiles/public-profiles-sitemaps-index.xml): Sitemap index for public fund manager and firm profile pages.

Private markets data you can't get anywhere else

Make informed investment decisions with comprehensive, accurate, and timely private markets data. Whether you are raising capital, sourcing deals and investments, analyzing performance, or just want to stay informed – we have the data you need.

Private equity

Leverage the world’s largest private equity database to identify the performance data, research, and market intelligence you need to achieve high absolute returns.

Learn more

Hedge funds

Enhance your portfolio with the breadth and quality of our hedge funds data – covering investors, funds, fund performance, fund terms, service providers, and more.

Learn more

Venture capital

Looking for funds with high growth potential? Be the first to identify market opportunities with our extensive venture capital coverage – encompassing portfolio companies, investors, deals & exits, and more.

Learn more

Real estate

Find your next opportunity in real assets with access to wide-ranging real estate data that covers investors, fund performance, fund terms, assets, service providers, and more.

Learn more

Private credit

Discover unlisted funds with attractive risk-adjusted returns through our extensive private credit coverage – including funds, fund performance, fund terms, investors, deals & exits, and more.

Learn more

Infrastructure

Maximize your long-term yields with access to wide-ranging infrastructure data across funds, industry verticals, fund performance, fund terms, investors, deals & exits, and more.

Learn more

Secondaries

Access reliable and timely secondaries data with coverage across investors, fund performance, fund terms, assets, service providers, and more.

Learn more

Natural resources

Take advantage of a wide range of opportunities in natural resources with access to best-in-class data on funds, fund performance, and investors across the asset class.
